Body.Content:
The public preview of SharePoint Customize Forms introduces a responsive, multi-column starting layout for new forms in eligible commercial SharePoint tenants. Makers can customize these forms while preserving their connection to SharePoint list actions. Existing customized forms retain their current layouts.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/sharepoint-form-integration

GA date: February CY2027

Preview date: November CY2026
